thread:
Jordan: FYI — Cobalt just told us governance review + quota confirmation is blocking the exec sign-off. They need a dataflow diagram, egress commitments, and a committed monthly token floor by EOD Friday.
Maya: Got it. I can put together a dataflow + minimal access matrix. Will need Diego to confirm peering feasibility (VPC) and egress limits.
Diego: Quick note — our current private deployment egress for eu-west-1 has a soft cap at 5TB/mo without upgrade. We can request burst increase but that adds lead time.
Priya: Legal here. For their questionnaire we need: DPIA section answers, vendor DPA excerpt, and KMS attestation language. I can draft the DPA snippet if someone drops the flow diagram.
Jordan: @Sam can you escalate for a short exec bridge? Cobalt wants finance comfort on committed spend + potential overage handling.
Sam: On it. I'll loop in finance and schedule a 30-min bridge for tomorrow 10am PT. 
sec-bot: New file uploaded: Cobalt_SecQ_2026_v2.pdf (owner: Jordan)
Maya: Copied the sec question list. I'll attach a simple sequence diag and an access matrix by 3pm.
Diego: For peering, quick checklist I'm running now:
```
- verify VPC CIDR overlap
- confirm route table propagation
- run connectivity smoke: curl -sS http://internal-health:8080/health
```
Diego: Curl returns 200 in our staging test. Production network review should be straightforward but needs ticketed peering approval.
Priya: Draft DPA snippet ready. Uploading as DPA_Cobalt_draft.docx. Jordan, please confirm if customer insists on additional audit rights beyond SOC2.
Jordan: They asked for SOC2 + on-demand penetration test reports. We usually provide SOC2 and discuss pt report cadence.
Maya: I'll include a footnote about regular pentest cadence and our breach notification SLA.
Sam: Finance question — what does a conservative committed monthly floor look like? Maya/Diego, any quick ballpark for cost at 10M tokens/mo?
Maya: Rough calc: with current hosting profile and batching assumptions, 10M tokens ≈ $6k-$8k/mo hosted. If private/dedicated, add reserved capacity delta — probably +$12k/mo. I'll produce a short cost table.
Jordan: Action items: 1) Maya — dataflow + cost table by 3pm. 2) Diego — open peering ticket + estimated lead time by EOD. 3) Priya — upload DPA draft and highlight gaps vs customer asks. 4) Sam — schedule finance bridge and send invite.
Sam: Bridge invite sent to Cobalt execs + our legal + finance for Tue 10am PT. Please accept.
Priya: Uploaded DPA_Cobalt_draft.docx and a redline checklist called Cobalt_DPA_gaps.txt. 
Maya: Uploading diagrams: Cobalt_dataflow_v1.svg and access_matrix.csv (permissions least-privilege).
Diego: Peering ticket created: PEER-4821. ETA for approval 3 business days if no infra changes.
Jordan: Customer asked if we can carve out an interim commitment (2 months) while they finish procurement. Thoughts?
Sam: We can offer a 2-month trial with a minimum commitment and conversion credit. I'll run exact wording with finance after the bridge.
Maya: If they take trial, I'll add mitigations (rate limits + burst protect) so we don't overspend.
Jordan: Thanks all — will update Cobalt after the bridge. Please drop any docs into this thread if you upload new versions so I can reference them on the call. :thumbsup:
Priya: Noted. If legal needs anything else before the bridge ping me here.
Maya: Done — files attached to thread.
Diego: Marking PEER-4821 as linked to thread.
Sam: Post-bridge plan: if exec approves, we'll have finance produce SOW and legal finalize DPA within 48h.
Jordan: Closing loop later with minutes. Appreciate the quick turnaround team. :rocket:
